style_suggestion.reasoning: The site sells the golf-course and canyon setting through the seasons (Outdoors: golf grounds). The page meta mentions 'rustic charm with modern comforts', but that is SEO text, and the corrected Description has no Rustic or Modern cue. A public golf course event center is not 'super fancy', so Luxury (country club / golf club) does not fit.
